subtitle: Lesson 59 · Querying with Cypher

code:
MATCH (p:Person)-[:WORKS_AT]->(c:Company)
RETURN p.name, c.name

(node)        = parentheses
[:REL_TYPE]   = brackets, on a dash
-->           = direction of the
                stored relationship
caption: No JOIN syntax — the relationship already exists as a stored pointer.

code:
RETURN p.name AS employeeName
RETURN DISTINCT c.name
RETURN p.name, c.name LIMIT 10
RETURN p            // whole node, all props
caption: Cypher's RETURN is the analog of a SQL SELECT list.
